connector.name: Autowhisper MCP
connector.registryDescription: Drive your AutoWhisper AI CMO to generate and publish marketing content from any MCP client.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package autowhisper-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the xnjiang account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.description: Override the API base URL for self-hosted or staging instances.
